sources.title: Concordia AtoM - Kamp Kanawana sub-series P0145/12B (full finding aid)
sources.notes: Comprehensive extraction of Kamp Kanawana sub-series P0145/12B and all 7 sub-sub-series (12B01-12B07) plus parent fonds P0145 and series 12A. Direct page access blocked (403); data extracted via search engine indexing. 7.72m of textual records, photographs, objects, maps, drawings, audio, film. Dates [190-]-2003. Sub-sub-series: General admin (directors reports 1910-1969, committee records 1910-1969), Financial admin, Land/facilities (blueprints, maps), Communications (Green Triangle 1932-1940, KA-News 1976-1982, Gas Bag 1923, brochures 1921-2001, radio broadcasts 1936-1941), Staff/counsellors (Dimock research studies 1960-1961), Campers (applications, rosters), Program (ceremonies: firelighting 1936, fire of friendship 1939; pageant scripts 1931-1932; canoe trip logs 1945-1946; song books 1941-1945; winter outing club 1970s-1979).

sources.title: Concordia AtoM - YMCA of Montreal Fonds P0145 (overview)
sources.notes: Parent fonds P0145. Documents Montreal YMCA from founding Nov 1851 to late 20th century. Includes Harold C. Cross and Murray C. Ross research materials. 15 series. Donated to Concordia 2000-2005 from Norris Building. PDF finding aid available at concordia.accesstomemory.org/downloads/ymca-of-montreal-fonds-2.pdf. Series 12 covers all camping programs including 14 sub-series (12A-12N): Kanawana, Otoreke, Becsies, Dorval, Weredale, Perrot, Ski lodge, Thunderbird, Wilderness Survival, Voyageurs de la Vérendrye, Lac St-Joseph/Camp Jubilee, Day camp, Camping associations.

sources.title: Concordia AtoM - Kanawana General Administration P0145/12B01
sources.notes: Directors/season reports: First Year 1910, 1918, 1919, 1921. Committee records: KK Committee 1910-1917, 1918-1923 (scrapbook), 1923-1939 (scrapbook), 1935-1938. Board of Management 1939, 1940-1942. Microfiches: Junior Camp Opening Roster 1924-1939 (6), Permanent Camp Committee 1911-1926 (3). Notable: Kanawana Reminiscence by Ben T. Hannah 1989; KK Facts timeline 1894-1998; wildlife sanctuary proposal 1847/1954-1960; Annual Kommittee Konference 1961.

sources.title: Concordia AtoM - Kanawana Communications P0145/12B04
sources.notes: Newsletters: Green Triangle 1932-1940, KA-News/Green Triangle 1976/1978-1982, Gas Bag 1923, The Look Out 1994, The Chestnut 1965. Brochures 1921-2001. Radio broadcasts 1936-1941. T-shirt artwork 1987/1988/1991/1997. Poster '100 years of spirit and leadership' 1994. '95 years of sharing' reunion films 1989. Song 'On My Way to Kanawana' by Richard Itch Kerr.

sources.title: Concordia AtoM - Kanawana Program P0145/12B07
sources.notes: Ceremonies: firelighting 1936, fire of friendship/Kanawana show 1939, KK pageant scripts 1931-1932, all-season camper banquets 1938-1939. Water/canoe: safety training/drills/pageants 1931, canoe care/water safety 1933, aquatics forms 1943, canoe trip log 1945, canoe trip reports 1946. Music: song sheets/skits 1925/1927, song books 1941-1945. Programs: 'Democratic Program Building' 1927, astronomy 1930s, forestry training proposal, horseback riding 1971, Winter Outing Club 1970s-1979, day camp tripping 1979. Winter ski camp 1945-1947.

sources.title: BAnQ Numérique - Digitized Newspaper Collections (La Presse, La Tribune, The Gazette, Montreal Herald, etc.)
sources.notes: BAnQ digitizes Quebec historical newspapers with OCR full-text search. The Gazette, La Presse, Montreal Herald, La Tribune, Le Soleil, and others are searchable. Web fetches return 403 — requires direct browser access to search interface at numerique.banq.qc.ca. Key newspapers for Kanawana research: The Gazette (English, 1778-present), Montreal Star (English, 1869-1979), La Presse (French, 1884-present), Montreal Herald (English, 1811-1957). All likely contain camp mentions.
